name: app.travelrightnow/travel-right-now
title: Travel Right Now
description: Dated travel conditions for Cancún, Costa Rica, Hawaii, Iceland and Turks and Caicos, plus tours.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description:
List the destinations that have current travel conditions, with each one's
last update date and topics. Use it when unsure whether a destination is covered.

tools.name: get_conditions
tools.description:
Get current travel conditions for one destination: weather and road alerts,
volcano activity, closures, park and attraction reservations, flights, entry
rules, safety, costs and upcoming events. Use when someone asks what is happening
now, or whether something is open, running or safe.

topic is optional and narrows the results (for example weather, driving,
volcanoes, northern-lights).

topic.description: Optional topic, e.g. weather or driving

tools.name: what_changed
tools.description:
Get a destination's travel conditions that were confirmed or updated on or
after a date (YYYY-MM-DD), newest first. Use when someone asks what is new or
has changed recently.

tools.name: check_trip
tools.description:
Get the conditions relevant to a planned trip, given a destination, start and
end dates (YYYY-MM-DD) and optional interests such as 'volcano', 'northern
lights', 'driving' or 'beach'. Returns alerts first, then other relevant items,
with booking options where available. Entry rules, safety and weather are
always included. Items reflect conditions as of their as_of date, not
forecasts for the trip dates.

tools.name: find_tours
tools.description:
Find specific bookable tours and activities on Viator for a destination and an
activity, for example 'Arenal volcano hike' in Costa Rica, 'snorkel' in Turks and
Caicos or 'northern lights' in Iceland. Returns each tour's title, from-price,
rating, review count, duration, free-cancellation flag and booking link, plus any
current conditions from the destination's data that could affect the activity.
Use when someone is choosing or asking which tour or activity to book.

activity.description: What they want to do, e.g. 'Arenal volcano hike'
